description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Being part of the Marketing team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest-growing companies ever. Be prepared for a hectic, fast-paced, and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

You will be constantly seeking solutions that scale, while overseeing the growth of our business. Your processes and projects will directly contribute to DiDi's growth in Mexico!

In this role, you'll be...


A creative, analytical, and motivated person who wants to begin a career in the Marketing team.
Providing significant support to the Marketing Manager in the Marketing Daily User Campaigns, Analytics, and Reporting. 
Deep diving into customer service interactions to identify qualitative insights and improvement opportunities.
Supporting market research and A/B tests to identify opportunities.
Benchmarking analysis and reporting, highlighting relevant insights. 
Supporting Marketing campaigns impacting traffic, growth, and engagement.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Students of bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Administration or Business. 
Fluent in English and Spanish.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
Knowledge and interest in data analysis applied to business and marketing.
Deeper interest in Marketing Strategy. 
Interest in a hands-on team player role, as well as a self-driven way of working.
Creative and analytical thinking. 
Decision-making based on data and insights.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

¡ATRÉVETE A SER PARTE DEL DESAFÍO! ¡VEN Y ÚNETE A NUESTRO EQUIPO JUNTOS PODEMOS MARCAR LA DIFERENCIA!

¿Sabías que Accenture está liderando la transformación digital en el mundo?

Accenture es una empresa líder mundial de servicios profesionales, que ofrece una amplia gama de servicios y soluciones en estrategia, consultoría, digital, tecnología y operaciones. Nuestro principal propósito es colaborar con nuestros clientes, para que puedan convertirse en negocios de alto rendimiento. Elaborar reportes de desempeño y seguimiento de indicadores.

Identificar oportunidades para incrementar eficiencia y resultados de negocio.



La posición requiere un perfil analítico, orientado a resultados y con conocimientos en marketing digital, medición y optimización de campañas.

Accenture no discrimina por motivos de raza, religión, color, sexo, edad, discapacidad, nacionalidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, ni por ninguna otra razón cubierta por la legislación local.

Required Qualifications

High coachability and openness to receiving and acting on feedback

B2B marketing experience
Background in education, travel, or study abroad
U.S. market experience

Location: Remote (LATAM Applicants Only)

Coordinar los requerimientos aplicables para el lanzamiento de las campañas y programas especiales de servicio; herramienta especial, refacciones, entrenamiento a dealer, etc.

Publicar boletín con la información relacionada para su consulta por parte de la red de distribuidores.
Monitorear el cumplimiento de campañas en la red de distribuidores, notificando oportunidades de VIN afectados no atendidos en distribuidor.
Implementar programas y estrategias de cumplimiento por parte de los distribuidores Mazda.
Traducir y publicar literatura técnica.
Monitorear publicaciones técnicas aplicables al mercado mexicano, a través de la documentación emitida por Mazda Corporation Japón (MC) / Mazda Norteamérica (MNAO).

Traducir los programas e información de servicio aplicables de inglés a español, y notificar al equipo de operaciones técnicas, a fin de que esta información sirva para enriquecer el conocimiento técnico de reparación de los vehículos Mazda, tanto de uso interno como a la red de distribuidores Mazda.

Publicar la información traducida elegible en el portal de soporte servicio (MGSS) y de esta manera esté disponible para la implementación correcta de las campañas y programas de servicio en la red Mazda.

title: Paid Search Senior Specialist
skills: Support the building and executing of Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, inventory, and ecommerce or lead gen realities; surface trade‑offs and options.
Communicate performance and recommendations clearly to internal partners and clients; contribute to QBRs with actionable next steps.
Use platform capabilities (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), feed tools, and responsible automation (e.g., value‑based bidding, Performance Max) to improve efficiency and outcomes.
Apply Bliss Point insights (e.g., Always‑On Incrementality, Forecasting, Creative Insights) to inform optimizations; flag data quality issues and provide structured feedback to product teams.

Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights, Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4, advanced Excel/Sheets; ability to build clear performance narratives and basic forecasts; design/run A/B tests.
Communication and collaboration: Clear client‑facing updates; cross‑functional teamwork; ability to mentor and delegate work to more junior team members.
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a plus.
Efficient growth: Improve efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue targets.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting spend; improve feed/tagging fidelity; reduce rework.
Product/AI usage: Pilot and adopt relevant platform/Bliss Point features with documented impact.
description:
About the job

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Search Senior Specialist, you will plan, build, and optimize Paid Search and Shopping programs that drive efficient client growth. You’ll execute high-quality campaign management, translate performance data into clear actions, and apply automation and Bliss Point insights to reduce waste and improve outcomes. You’ll set and deliver Rocks with directional KPIs, collaborate across Analytics, Creative, Product/Bliss Point, and Client Leadership, and mentor junior teammates. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric


Support the building and executing of Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, inventory, and ecommerce or lead gen realities; surface trade‑offs and options.
Communicate performance and recommendations clearly to internal partners and clients; contribute to QBRs with actionable next steps.


Product‑Led


Use platform capabilities (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), feed tools, and responsible automation (e.g., value‑based bidding, Performance Max) to improve efficiency and outcomes.
Apply Bliss Point insights (e.g., Always‑On Incrementality, Forecasting, Creative Insights) to inform optimizations; flag data quality issues and provide structured feedback to product teams.


Data & Measurement‑Driven


Monitor performance daily/weekly; analyze trends; design basic A/B tests with success criteria; forecast expected impact where feasible.
Maintain data integrity (tagging, feeds, tracking); partner with Analytics to validate reads and address anomalies.


The Tinuiti Way


Demonstrate deep Paid Search/Shopping craft with growing awareness of adjacent channels; connect measurement to growth; document playbooks and “how‑to” guides for repeatability.

title: GTM Strategy Analyst
skills: Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng
Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado

description:
About the job

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Position Title: Consumer Marketing Associate

Job Level: P2 Location: Mexico

Supervisor: Joseba Barriola Potts

Consumer Experience and Innovation is a core marketing role to build and advance the consumer marketing capability of the Eli Lilly Mexico Affiliate. The position works with internal partners (brand teams, global teams, subject matter experts) as well as external partners (creative agencies, media agencies, tech & health start-ups) as the owner/leader of the project to develop & execute industry-leading and holistic consumer marketing strategies/plans based on deep customer insights understanding.

The associate needs deep understanding of customer insights and ability to couple that understanding with brand strategies to develop and execute successful plan/campaigns for the high specialty indications. The associate demonstrates an innate motivation to be on the leading edge, to shape the future, and to create experiences that make the unimaginable possible for our customers.

The Position

We are seeking a talented and strategic-minded individual to join our team as a Consumer Marketing Associate. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing consumer-centric strategies to drive brand awareness, engagement, and loyalty among patients and healthcare consumers in high specialty indications. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping the company's approach to connecting with end-users, understanding their needs, and fostering meaningful relationships through full funnel strategies.

As a Consumer Strategy Associate, your main responsibilities will be to:


Develop and implement content-driven campaigns aimed at educating patients and encouraging them to seek medical treatment for high specialty indications.
Innovate approaches for patient interaction, including the creation of new solutions, digital ecosystems, and collaboration initiatives in the field of patient engagement.
Guide brand teams in identifying consumer insights by collaborating with Market Research and Creative Agency partners. Ensure a comprehensive understanding of all consumer insights and identify the most relevant ones for the overall brand strategy.
Take the lead in developing consumer messaging and actively collaborate with agencies
Lead ideation and development of novel strategies to reach and support customers, such as exploring opportunities in digital health, based on the business needs.
Develop social media partnerships with platforms, channels, digital Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), patient, KOLs, and other collaborations as needed, to promote disease awareness and education.
Monitor metrics and adjust campaign parameters to enhance overall impact.
Formulate and execute the operational Patient Engagement plan in alignment with the patient engagement strategy.
Establish and nurture networks and partnerships with relevant stakeholders.
Assist brand teams in shaping their consumer marketing strategies, including the selection of target consumer segments, development of Patient Journey, and definition of brands’ Critical Success Factors.



Qualifications

About You


At least 2 years relevant marketing experience – consumer related marketing strategy and tactic development
Experience managing a digital marketing environment (consumer journey) and key digital metrics
Experience leading and/or managing multi-layered project(s) involving cross-functional/ cross-national working groups
Experience working with/managing creative agencies and/or other vendor partners
Tactic measurement and analytics experience
Strong English skills to be able to collaborate with global counterparts with multinational backgrounds.
You have a solid understanding and knowledge of digital/multi-channel marketing, incl. experience with digital tools and (social) media platforms. Experience with digital media execution
You have solid project management experience and skills.



Location: Mexico

Additional Information


Some travel is possible, up to 5-15%

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As Campaign&Market Senior Analyst at DiDi, you will turn large-scale mobility and platform data into clear performance insights that directly drive growth and campaign strategies. You will be responsible for end-to-end campaign measurement, market diagnosis, and cross-functional performance reporting that support both operation team and leadership.

In this role, you'll be...


Design and delivery of campaign measurement frameworks, producing dashboards for result tracking and campaign selections. 
Partner with Operations, Marketing, Product teams to translate analytical findings into optimized campaign tactics, and go-to-market strategies that drive measurable uplifts.
Own stakeholder communication for analytics outcomes, producing clear executive-ready briefings and playbooks that enable local teams to replicate successful tactics at country and city scales.
Develop and maintain city diagnosis models that quantify business initiatives and results, transfer them into actionable plans. 



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Education: Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field is preferred; an advanced degree is a plus but not mandatory.
Technical skills: Demonstrated proficiency with SQL for large-scale data extraction, Python or R for statistical modeling, and experience with BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Superset) to create automated dashboards.
Analytics experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in marketing analytics, campaign measurement, or growth analytics at a consumer internet, mobility, or marketplace company.
Business acumen: Strong understanding of performance marketing levers, campaign measurement, and unit economics in two-sided marketplace environments, with experience translating metrics into budget and product recommendations.
Communication and influence: Clear storytelling skills with experience presenting complex analyses to senior stakeholders and regional teams, and the ability to drive cross-functional alignment.
Personal qualities: Results-driven, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a fast-paced matrix organization, and adaptable to shifting priorities across multiple countries and product lines.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

SimplePractice is headquartered in Los Angeles, California, but we have team members who work and live across the United States, Dominican Republic, Mexico City, and Ukraine.



At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice. 



More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients. 



Award-winning and people-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. Recognized by MedTech Breakthrough, the Digital Health Awards, Best Places to Code in Mexico and Built In's Best Places to Work.



Our Culture



At SimplePractice, culture is our foundation. It influences the way we work, how we serve our customers, and how we approach accomplishing our mission. We have five core values that we strive to embody every day:

We think big
We take simplicity seriously
We come as we are
We act with humility
We are built on trust

Culture is everyone’s responsibility at SimplePractice. Our culture is what drives us to do better for our teammates and customers.



Connection and collaboration are also key to our success. You will work with our talented multi-national teams and have opportunities to participate in onsites in both the US and Mexico.



The Role



SimplePractice is hiring for an experienced Software Engineer to join our team in a hybrid role. The ideal candidate will have expert-level knowledge in Ruby on Rails and extensive backend development experience. This role will be instrumental in implementing a wide variety of planned features and service enhancements to support our growing platform.

You are a passionate, talented engineer who is willing to push the limits of existing technology to create the best possible user experience
You work on the front-end with heavier emphasis on the backend to develop new features from start to finish, including design of architecture, coding, and testing
You are delighted by good design and bring that taste to your front-end work
You love building products that help 200,000+ customers in their day-to-day life

Build out the next generation practice management platform
Work with our Engineering Leadership and Talent group to scale our new office in Mexico City
Collaborate with our Product group to help understand customer needs, troubleshoot potential problems and define upcoming features

You possess solid experience in at least one modern JavaScript framework, specifically Ember.js or React.js, and the ecosystem around those frameworks

You have experience taking Rails apps from idea to production
You understand the value and nuances of Test-Driven Development

About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Marketing Associate 

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Marketing Associate , you won't just be watching from the sidelines; you will be hands-on from day one, collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate complex technical innovations into compelling market value.

Location: This role will be based remote globally

What Your Day Will Look Like


GTM Support: Contribute to go-to-market planning and execution. 
Storytelling: Draft and edit compelling messaging and positioning that highlights business value for diverse target audiences. 
Campaign Coordination: Assist in developing campaign plans and content dissemination strategies to ensure our message reaches the right people. 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other demand generation and digital teams to help optimize marketing funnels and track campaign performance. 
Event & Social Support: Work with the wider marketing team to coordinate webinars, events, and social media promotions. 



What We Are Looking For In You


Tech Curiosity: A genuine passion for technology and a desire to learn about open source. 
Analytical Thinking: An ability to break down complex issues and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations. 
Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships within a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. 
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; you enjoy storytelling and creating impactful content. 
Proactive Mindset: A self-starter who can prioritize tasks effectively and meet deadlines in a dynamic setting. 
Foundational Knowledge: A basic understanding of marketing principles or go-to-market strategies (via your degree, internships, or personal projects). 
Growth Mindset: Someone who is eager to learn, open to feedback, and not afraid to take on new challenges. 



What We Offer You

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

Most design jobs hand you a brief and want it back unchanged. This one isn't that. You're building ad creative for DTC e-comm brands with real scale behind them, working inside a shop of performance marketers who play at an elite level, and your work is what gets tested in front of real ad spend. Static, video, motion graphics: you bring the concept to life and then sharpen it again based on what the data and the team tell you.

We're small, fast-growing, fully remote, and built around people who want to keep getting better.




What you'll do

Build the ad creative. Static images, video, and motion graphics for client campaigns. This is the core of the role.
Iterate fast. Take feedback from the team and from client results, and turn it into a sharper next version.
Work as part of a team. You're collaborating closely with the people running strategy and client relationships.
Keep client variety in view. Most of our clients are DTC e-commerce brands in the US, with some in Canada, Australia, and elsewhere.

5+ years creating graphic design and video content, with experience built for social media ads specifically.
Proficient in Photoshop and Illustrator.
Proficient in Premiere Pro and After Effects.
Proficient in Figma.
Comfortable working in English.
Relentlessly detail-oriented, the kind of person who notices the thing everyone else scrolled past.

Performance. Your creative is built to convert, not just to look good in isolation.
Quality. The work is sharp, on-brand, and detail-checked every time.
Responsiveness. Feedback turns into improvement fast.
Growth. You're visibly better at this six months from now than you are today.




How you'll work

This is a collaborative role on a fast-moving team. We keep core hours on US Eastern (9-6 ET) and expect real availability during that window. This is a focused, full-time commitment: we don't take on people who are working this role alongside another full-time job.

Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills

To be a curious, quick learner who thrives in a collaborative and fast-paced environment

Create high-quality custom illustrations, including logos, mascots, icons, character art, and brand illustrations that align with the client’s vision.
Communicate directly with clients to clarify briefs, request inputs, and align on expectations.
You own the final quality and artistic alignment of your work. While Art Directors (ADs) are available as a resource for suggestions, you determine how and whether feedback is applied.
Coordinate with other creatives when working with the same client.
Use AI tools, Adobe Creative Cloud, and illustration tools to accelerate drafting and ideation without sacrificing originality, brand accuracy, or your unique artistic touch.




Why join Flocksy?

Full Flexibility: You have full flexibility over how you structure your time and are not required to follow a set schedule. How you manage your day is entirely up to you.
Choose your workload: You decide how many clients to take on. The choice is yours based on your interest and availability. Work volume can vary week to week depending on client activity.
Supportive environment: You are not alone. Production Coordinators (PCs) help you identify good client fits or navigate blockers, while Art Directors (ADs) provide creative guidance when you need it.




What we are looking for:

Contractors who are proactive and take ownership of the clients they choose to work with.
A strong portfolio showing custom illustration, vector art, character design, icons, logos, or brand-focused illustration work. Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud, especially Illustrator and Photoshop.
As an independent contractor, you provide your own computer and software tools, such as a drawing tablet, Adobe Creative Cloud, AI tools, and any other tools necessary to complete the work for clients.
Professionals who manage communication directly with their clients, with general availability during overlapping business hours to support client collaboration, managed at the contractor’s discretion.
Clear English skills to manage direct client relationships and document updates in project notes.




What we offer

100% remote work (LatAm based).
Access to a flow of global clients, where your workload depends on the clients you choose to take on.
Weekly payments.
Total autonomy over your own schedule.




About Flocksy

Flocksy is a global creative platform that helps businesses scale through consistent, high-quality design, video, and marketing support. We’ve built a modern production system designed for speed, consistency, and long-term partnerships, where creatives don’t jump between random one-off projects, but instead grow alongside a dedicated group of brands over time.




If you enjoy consistent creative work opportunities, direct client relationships, and the autonomy to fully own your craft in a fast-moving remote environment, we’d love to meet you!

Content goes live accurately, on time, and with fewer preventable issues.

About the job

Job Description

As a User Experience Designer II here at Honeywell, you will shape user experiences, collaborate with teams, and lead design processes to create intuitive, user-centric solutions that meet business objectives. You will report directly to our Director User Exp Design and you’ll work out of our Mexico City location on a Hybrid work schedule.

We are looking for a strong team member who can collaborate across multiple ongoing programs to deliver cohesive, end-to-end user experience across all touchpoints for the Productivity Business. This role requires applying well-established human-centered design principles to ensure Honeywell products and applications are highly useful, usable, and desirable in the marketplace.

You will be part of the HUE (Honeywell User Experience) team, which is responsible for delivering differentiated designs that enable our users to perform their day-to-day activities as efficiently and effectively as possible. Our multidisciplinary team includes User Researchers who deeply understand end-user needs, Industrial Designers who create physical products, and Digital Designers (UI/UX) who craft digital experiences.

In this role, you will also collaborate closely with Offering Managers and Developers to align on requirements and deliverables, supporting interface design across web, desktop, mobile, and embedded platforms.

Responsibilities

Understand requirements by asking insightful and clarifying questions


 Translate requirements into clear user flows and wireframes 
 Create visual designs aligned with Honeywell’s design system 
 Build reusable components to grow the design system (auto layout, variants) 
 Develop both low-fidelity and high-fidelity prototypes with use of variables 
 Support Senior Designers in big projects as a team player 
 Collaborate within a multidisciplinary team, including Marketing and Engineering 
 Communicate status, progress, and deliverables effectively and proactively 
 Act as a continuous advocate for the user throughout the design process 
 Contribute to product development using a human-centered design approach 


Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE


 Bachelor’s degree in Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Product Design, or a related field 
 5+ years of industry experience in UI design (portfolio required) 
 Proficiency with the Figma suite 
 Experience defining product experiences, including personas and user journeys 
 Strong experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and visual design concepts 
 Experience designing complex mobile and web applications, including dashboards and data-intensive solutions 
 A curious, adaptable, and self-driven mindset with strong interpersonal skills 
 Excellent communication skills, with fluency in English (both written and verbal) 


WE VALUE


 Experience with observational research and usability testing 
 Experience using UI libraries 
 Demonstrated ability to scope, plan, and execute projects within an iterative development process 
 Knowledge of Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) and inclusive design practices 


About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

Are you a finance or accounting professional who loves solving software puzzles and helping clients succeed?




We are a leading financial budgeting, forecasting, and reporting software provider designed specifically to empower mid-market corporate finance teams. In this role, you won't be reading from a scripted call-center prompt. Instead, you will act as a true consultative partner, leveraging your financial acumen to guide users through intricate software workflows, troubleshoot complex reporting queries, and help organizations manage massive operations smoothly.




Key Responsibilities




Conduct live, consultative Zoom and Microsoft Teams support and training sessions with corporate finance users
Guide customers through critical financial software workflows, including budget roll forwards, forecast creation, payroll forecasting, allocations, and ERP data exports/imports
Efficiently respond to incoming customer emails and technical support tickets regarding workflow and reporting concerns

Update customer-facing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), author clear help topics and FAQ documentation, and log recurring issues to optimize internal support processes




Must-Have Requirements




Strong, bilingual spoken and written communication skills in both English and Spanish
Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working directly with financial budgeting or reporting software platforms
A polished, professional customer presence with the confidence to lead live screenshare troubleshooting sessions and ask clarifying questions
Deep understanding of the operational challenges involved in managing large, complex corporate budgets
Direct experience creating SOPs, training materials, or technical knowledge base articles
Highly proficient with Microsoft Excel, standard ticketing/helpdesk systems, and virtual meeting tools (Zoom/Teams)
A reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet dedicated home office environment, a functional webcam, and a dual-monitor setup




Nice-to-Have Requirements




Prior support experience specifically tailored to ERP systems or mid-market accounting software
Hands-on experience utilizing industry-standard helpdesk software such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, or Zoho Desk
Familiarity or exposure to specialized financial reporting tools, business intelligence platforms, or budgeting software (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Solver, Jet Reports, Velixo, Vena, Prophix, Planful, Adaptive Planning, Datarails, Martus, or Forecaster)




Why Join Us




This is an exceptional entry point into an innovative tech space that values your accounting and financial expertise. We believe in setting our team up for long-term success, which is why you will receive comprehensive, hands-on training—from shadowing live support calls to practicing in dedicated demo environments before taking full ownership of client accounts.

Malvern Panalytical instruments analyze the chemical, physical and structural nature of materials, from proteins to polymers and semiconductors to minerals. Micromeritics manufactures systems for the characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials for a wide- range of end markets including catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery. description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The Team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Our API support team handles inquiries from clients using our API to implement various projects, from mobile apps, to high frequency trading bots, to other exchanges sourcing our liquidity.

You will work closely with our entire range of retail, VIP, and Institutional clients, answering API related questions and solving technical API issues, while providing the excellent customer experience our clients expect from Kraken.

The Opportunity

As an API specialist you will be the first point of contact when our clients need assistance with our REST, WebSocket, and FIX APIs.


Answer clients’ API questions via text and live support channels (Zendesk/Email/Telegram/Zoom).
Assist colleagues with API inquiries and projects involving API use cases.
Diagnose and provide solutions for clients’ API related issues.
Assist clients in implementing their API code (provide integration advice, debug client code, provide code examples).
Develop and maintain our official API libraries/wrappers in multiple programming languages.
Maintain internal and client facing API documentation, support content, and training resources.
Provide testing and feedback for new API features before they are released to clients.
Perform API related engineering tasks (API onboarding, firewall management, networking configuration).
Assist in the management of our API support team (QA for other specialists, etc.).


What You Bring


Knowledge and experience of at least one programming language (Python. JavaScript, C/C++/C#, Rust, for example).
Understanding of REST, WebSocket, and FIX API functionality.
Experience interpreting multiple data formats (JSON, CSV, XML, FIX 4.4, etc.).
Experience managing hosts (AWS instances, for example) and networks (firewall configuration, etc.).
Ability to write complex technical documentation in a human friendly format.
Good interpersonal skills, and excellent communication abilities.


Nice To Haves


Experience writing trading related code for REST, WebSocket, or FIX APIs (not necessarily crypto).
Experience with Google Sheets, Google Script, SQL, and other data tools.
Experience with third party API tools (Postman, N8N, for example).
UNIX command line knowledge (bash/sed/awk/grep/expect/etc.)
Language ability (in addition to English).

Our commitment

description:
About the job

TikTok Shop & Influencer Marketing Manager

TopFoxx | Remote | Full-Time

 

Location: Remote (must work U.S. East Coast hours).

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. Hours are flexible. We care about performance, not clocks.

Salary: $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.

Language: Perfect written and spoken English is required (this is non-negotiable), along with a deep understanding of U.S. culture, slang, and social media behavior.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned fashion startup reinventing the sunglasses industry with solution-oriented designs and bold branding. Since 2016, we have grown from a bootstrapped e-commerce brand into a global business serving hundreds of thousands of customers, backed by an engaged community of influencers and creators.

We are not here to follow trends. We create them. Our sunglasses are tangle-free, floatable, foldable, shatter-resistant, and sustainably made, and we are just getting started.

We are a small, lean, founder-led team of fewer than ten people, with only about three of us on marketing. That means there is nowhere to hide and no one to pass the work to. Everyone wears multiple hats, owns real outcomes, and what you build genuinely moves the company. We do not do slow. We move fast, we pivot often, and we only hire A-players who treat the business like their own.




The Role

You will be the main one. This is the person who owns influencer and affiliate marketing end to end at TopFoxx. You are not waiting for a manual or a list of tasks. You are expected to bring the strategy, bring the ideas, and then execute them yourself, fast.

This space changes daily. New creators, new trends, new platform rules. You have to move quickly, test constantly, double down on what converts, and cut what does not. We are not looking for someone who only posts and reports. We are looking for a real executor who is proactive, creative, and obsessed with one thing above all: profitable, converting partnerships.

This is a big opportunity, and we want to be honest with you: it is also real work. We already have a large base of affiliates and creators, but your job is to grow it, activate it, and make it far more profitable. This is not a coast-along role. You will be building, pushing, and problem-solving every single day. For the right person, that is exactly the appeal.

This is a high-ownership role with a direct path into leading the influencer marketing function as it scales.




Why This Is Worth It

Here is the honest pitch. This is not a maintenance job and it is not busywork. Influencer and affiliate marketing is one of the biggest growth levers we have, and we believe this channel can become a multi-million dollar engine for TopFoxx. We are looking for the person who can build that.

We reward outcomes, not hours. If you can show us you can grow this and drive real, profitable revenue, you grow with it. That means a clear path into leadership and compensation that reflects the results you create. The ceiling here is high for someone who actually delivers, and you will be able to point to a business you helped build, not just tasks you completed.

If you want to be a small piece of a big machine, this is not it. If you want real ownership, real upside, and to look back in a year knowing you built something that matters, keep reading.




1. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Program (Your Primary Focus)

This is the heart of the role and where most of your time and energy goes. The big one is affiliate. Your job is to make sure the affiliates are converting, the program is profitable, and the numbers in TikTok Shop Seller Center are strong and trending up.

Own TikTok Shop Seller Center day to day. Live in the dashboards, know your numbers cold, and make sure performance is healthy across GMV, conversion, and orders.
Make the affiliate program profitable. Track and grow GMV, revenue per creator, sample-to-sales ROI, and commission costs. Protect margin. Every dollar of product and commission has to earn its return.
Build and manage a pipeline of hundreds to thousands of active TikTok Shop affiliates, and keep them actually posting and selling, not just signing up.
Recruit high-converting creators and live sellers who know how to talk about product and drive sales, not just collect free samples.
Go live and sell yourself. You will host TikTok Lives, get on camera, and sell the glasses directly. Then you bring affiliates on, show them how it is done, and coach them to do the same.
Coordinate TikTok Live schedules with strong sellers, secure Spark Ads permissions, and optimize listings and content angles for maximum GMV.
Watch performance weekly. Scale top converters aggressively, and cut low performers fast.
Keep the data honest. No padded numbers, no inflated reporting. Decisions are only as good as the data behind them.




2. Instagram Influencers

Instagram is the second pillar. Here we work on gifting and affiliate only, so your skill is finding the right people and getting them to convert without a paid budget.

Source Instagram influencers who can actually sell, creators who understand product and know how to drive their audience to buy, not just post a pretty photo.
Run gifting-only and affiliate-only collaborations, and move creators from one gift to repeat posting to consistent affiliate sales.
Rebuild our existing relationships. We have lists of past and dormant influencers. A big part of this role is reigniting those relationships and turning old contacts back into active, converting partners.
Build genuine, consistent relationships so TopFoxx stays top of mind, through thoughtful, regular touchpoints across Instagram and DMs.




3. LTK, Affiliate Platforms & Onboarding Calls

The third pillar is affiliate-driven platforms like LTK, and just as important, getting on calls with creators. This role is not behind a screen all day. You have to be outgoing and genuinely good at talking to people.

Recruit and activate creators on LTK and other affiliate networks (Amazon, affiliate links) who are still actively driving commission-based sales.
Run weekly onboarding calls. You will be on calls regularly, onboarding new influencers, walking them through the program, and getting them excited and set up to post.
Get on calls and close collabs. Be confident and persuasive, build rapport quickly, and convince creators to say yes to working with us, often with gifting only.
Understand creator psychology and motivate influencers to post consistently through relationship, community value, and a clear win for them.




4. Strategy, Reporting & Full Influencer Marketing Scope

Because you own this function, you also handle everything a strong e-commerce influencer marketing lead would handle. Study what bigger e-commerce brands do, then adapt the best of it to a lean, fast-moving team.

Build the strategy. Bring a clear point of view on where influencer and affiliate marketing is going and how TopFoxx wins, then put it into action.
Plan and execute campaigns tied to product launches, holidays, seasonal moments, and major sales events (BFCM, summer, new drops).
Manage content calendars, gifting coordination, sample sends, and follow-ups so nothing slips.
Build weekly performance reports that connect activity to revenue, and use them to decide what to scale and what to kill.
Create simple SOPs, trackers, and playbooks as you go, so the program is repeatable and scalable as the team grows.
Collaborate with the creative, marketing, and product teams to keep messaging aligned, and step in on urgent launch-related projects when needed.
Stay ahead of trends, new creators, and new affiliate opportunities before competitors do.
Help with wider marketing as needed. With a team this small, marketing is just three people and everyone pitches in. From time to time things will come up across other marketing areas and departments that need a hand. We need someone proactive and solution-oriented who brings energy, jumps in, and helps build this with us rather than sitting idle.




Who You Are

Proactive: You see the gap and fill it. You bring the plan, you do not wait to be told.
A real executor: You move fast, ship daily, and adapt as things change hour to hour.
Analytical and profit-obsessed: You can read a Seller Center dashboard, understand ROI and margin, and turn data into decisions.
Persuasive and outgoing: You love talking to creators, you are comfortable on camera and on calls, and you can sell the partnership and the product.
Relationship-driven: You are a natural connector who builds loyalty and keeps partners coming back.
Organized under pressure: You can juggle hundreds of moving pieces without dropping the ball.




Required Experience & Skills

2+ years in influencer or affiliate marketing, preferably in fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or e-commerce / DTC.
Expert, hands-on knowledge of TikTok Shop Seller Center mechanics and affiliate programs.
Proven track record of generating real sales through gifting-only or zero-budget strategies.
Comfort with LTK, Amazon, and other affiliate platforms.
Comfortable on camera and hosting TikTok Lives to sell product directly.
Perfect written and spoken English, and a strong understanding of U.S. culture and digital trends. This is genuinely important.
KPI-driven, highly organized, and able to build simple systems and SOPs as you scale.




What You Get

Salary of $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.
A fully remote role on a fast-moving global team.
Real ownership of the influencer and affiliate function, with a path into leadership as it scales.
PTO including vacation, holidays, sick, personal, and mental health days.
Free TopFoxx products and partner brand perks.

About the job

Worldpanel by Nuerator, proporciona datos de consumidores que representan a casi 6 mil millones de consumidores en 65 países, ofreciendo a las marcas una visión multidimensional de cómo las personas piensan, cómo compran y cómo consumen, para que puedan establecer estrategias audaces e impulsar un impacto empresarial sostenible.




Objetivo

Apoyo a los equipos de trabajo en la elaboración de las presentaciones, análisis, casos de negocio y entregas de reportes periódicos.




Dependiendo del nivel de desarrollo, comienza a presentar ante los clientes, capacitar a compañeros de trabajo e involucrarse en ventas de servicios.




Funciones

Comprensión total de las variables del panel y análisis especiales.
Comprensión total de la forma de trabajo del cliente y garantizando la entrega de la información.
Desarrollo de análisis, briefs y casos prácticos solicitados por el cliente y prospectos.
Llevar una relación basada en la confianza, integridad, respeto y honestidad con los clientes y miembros del equipo de WP con el fin de mejorar la comunicación.
Visita autoservicios y canales de venta para analizar las categorías.
Buscar desarrollo comercial de clientes con nuevos servicios.
Apoyo en presentar casos de negocio en cliente.
Monitoreo de la competencia.
Prospección de clientes potenciales.




Habilidades

Comunicación, traduce información compleja en mensajes simples, útiles y accionables para el cliente. Sabe construir y contar historias que generen interés e impacto.
Vocación de servicio, entiende la necesidad/problema del negocio y del contacto, y lo acompaña en la solución.
Capacidad analítica, traduce datos en Insights potentes.
Vocación Comercial, capacidad de identificar oportunidades para ampliar el valor entregado a través del portafolio de soluciones de Worldpanel. La venta en Worldpanel es consultiva. El ejecutivo debe provocar, detectar problemáticas no explícitas, generar interés genuino por "ver más". Un ejecutivo que no provoca, deja valor sobre la mesa.
Ownership, "se hace cargo", se automotiva, anticipa, propone, es curioso, es una voz que se deja escuchar a su manera, imprime pasión en todo lo que hace

Licenciatura en áreas económico – administrativas, mercadotecnia e ingenierías con especialización en marketing.

Experiencia previa en investigación de mercados.

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?
